Elena / Ava —

Thanks for looping me in. I've done an initial pass on the GF_OrderForm_v1.pdf and flagged a few items that will need attention from the counterparty before we can proceed with signature:

Principal redline concerns (first pass):
- Section 4 (Limitation of Liability): request to add carveouts for gross negligence and willful misconduct — standard for us, counterparty language is broader than acceptable.
- Section 7 (Data Residency & Processing): Greenfield requests EU processing options; for the pilot you noted US-only, so we should add explicit confirmation in the MSA to prevent unintended multi-region routing.
- Section 9 (Indemnity): their proposed reciprocal indemnity looks fine, but the monetary cap needs alignment with our standard ($5M or revenue-based).
- Exhibit A (Service Levels): there are several SLA thresholds that are outside our typical guarantees for pilot usage; recommend we keep pilot SLOs lighter and include a path to upgrade in the Order Form.

Please ask Greenfield to complete the Redwood_MSA_Kickoff_Template.docx party details and provide: registered entity name, legal address, and authorized signer name + title. Also we need the billing contact (email + PO workflow) so the Order Form can be populated.

Security evidence request for triage (Soojin):
- SOC2 Type II report (last 12 months) or a completed security questionnaire.
- Encryption at rest/in-transit statement and whether they use any third-party processors for logs/telemetry.

I'll prepare a redline bundle (first pass) and upload to the Drive link Ava provided. Tentative timeline: I can get a first redline to you by end of day Monday (5/18) if the party details are filled in this week.

Kimberly Park
